title: Should you buy an Extended Warranty for your Toyota?
summary: A Toyota master technician walks through when an extended warranty is worth it, which exclusions matter most, and red flags like lifetime claims and uninspected online sellers.

assertions.quote: used cars is where i would recommend you buy an extended warranty
what it does not cover is the most important thing
none of extended warranties cover that... pre-existing conditions
never trust the lifetime powertrain warranties
you can actually negotiate that warranty with your selling dealer
you're keeping your car 10 years and the best extended warranty is six years is that worth it

verdicts.note: Straightforward consequence of paying for a fixed term or mileage cap you won't reach.

assertions.quote: be very wary of extended warranties that are sold online
